description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] and [50% Critical (15s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [General's Proclamation] to the user

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: General's Proclamation
description.text: Grants [60% Critical (15s)]/[80% Critical (15s)]/[100% Critical (15s)] and [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies after using 2/4/6+2n Knight abilities
